_comment: Colour literals that are allowed to survive the reskin, matched by FILE + LINE + LITERAL.
Never by literal alone: '#fff' appears 19 times in this repo and only three of them are
QR quiet zones. A literal-only allowlist would wave the other sixteen through.
Line numbers drift when a file is edited above the entry. tools/colour-census.js reports
an allowlist entry whose line no longer contains its literal as a STALE ENTRY rather than
silently ignoring it -- a stale allowlist is how a forbidden colour creeps back in.
